title: Eight-character procedural fighting-game action figure roster
movement_scope: Forward and backward only. No left/right locomotion animation or control is included.
rig_note: Articulated node hierarchy with named joint nodes and separate editable body-part meshes; not a fully weighted skinned Humanoid avatar.
customisation: Edit node transforms and materials in a glTF-compatible editor. Replace or refine head meshes and outfit meshes for higher likeness/detail.
disclaimer: These are procedural stylised base figures with visual likeness cues, not photorealistic sculpted likenesses. They are original game assets, not official representations.
